name: Tamie Wilson
subject: It’s time for a political renewal
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Everywhere I go, I hear it loud and clear – people are fed up with Jim Jordan and the division he and the ULTRA-MAGA movement have caused.
People are tired of the chaos, the hate, the fear.
There’s a new feeling in the air. It’s one of hope. It’s one of renewal.
And with your help, we can bring it to life.
Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 right now to fuel this campaign and help us turn the page on Jordan’s divisive reign? Together, we can start this renewal in our district and show the country what’s possible. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241018_renewal_link1]
When I talk about renewal, I see it as two things.
It’s a new dawn – a chance to leave behind this bitter political divide that has poisoned our communities for too long.
It’s a chance to say, “You know what, no, I’m not proud that our representative is known as the biggest angry bully in Congress.”
We can end the era of hate, fear, and violence that has consumed a major political party under the reign of Trump and Jordan.
The GOP has strayed so far from the light, from the ideals of neighborly support and kindness. It’s time for a renewal of our spirit, where we rise above the ugliness and choose hope over fear.
But renewal isn’t just about something new – it’s also a return.
A return to the values we once knew, where neighbors looked out for each other.
Where Main Street was alive with jobs, community, and camaraderie—not boarded-up windows, faded memories, and bitter local politics.
Growing up on my uncle’s farm, I remember Ohio as a hard-working, kind, and supportive place.
We can bring that back, but it starts with a political renewal. It starts with us.
Imagine an Ohio and a country where we leave the bullying and the bitterness behind.
Where we return to ourselves, not as Democrats and Republicans, but as friends, neighbors, and community members who lift each other up.
Where folks getting a little help to get by aren’t criticized, but embraced. Where corporations don’t run our country – we do.
Where women have full rights and control over their own bodies, and workers have fair pay and safe working conditions.
This is the renewal our campaign is fighting for.
We’ve got 18 days left to make this vision a reality. Jordan’s nervous because he knows change is coming.
Will you help us keep up the momentum? Your contribution today will ensure that we continue to reach voters and spread this message of hope and renewal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241018_renewal_link2]
This is the most important congressional race in the country. Together, we can renew not only our district but the very spirit of community and kindness that makes us proud to call this place home.
Let’s bring back the Ohio we all know and love.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
PS: If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]

Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. Democrats are really good at one thing – and one thing only, fellow patriot: **falsely accusing Republicans of what Democrats _themselves_ are guilty of.**

The Nebraska Election Integrity Training offers a comprehensive overview of the state election process and highlights the essential role that Poll Workers and Poll Watchers play in upholding election integrity. Please note that this training is closed to the press and may not be recorded.
**_FINAL Training Options:_**
**Virtual (Zoom) Trainings:**_ (register by clicking one of the days below)_
**[Tuesdays at 12:00 PM](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a818111a69&e=25844e23a8)**

**[Wednesday, October 23, 2024, at 10:00 AM](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ce6ba1da33&e=25844e23a8)**

**[Friday, October 25, 2024, at 6:00 PM](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2263a9714f&e=25844e23a8)**
Please allow 60-75 minutes for your training, though we aim to complete sessions in under an hour. Your participation is vital to ensuring free and fair elections in 2024. Feel free to share the registration links with friends and neighbors!
If you have completed the proper Nebraska Election Integrity training, it is crucial that we start shifting you!
We are offering three shifts for poll watchers in these precincts:
· **Morning** : 7:30 AM - 1:30 PM

A day later, elections expert and FiveThirtyEight founder Nate Silver said I've got "a puncher's chance of winning the Senate race" in Florida. And now, major outlets like The Hill are warning that "Rick Scott faces peril with abortion on Florida’s ballot," and The Washington Post is urging readers to "[k]eep your eye on the Florida Senate race." It goes to show that this people-powered movement has what it takes to retire Rick Scott this fall, confirming what I knew all along.= | | = But even with the new attention so close to Election Day, it still may not be enough to beat my megamillionaire opponent and his far-right PAC money. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Holy smokes, Peter. That was awesome.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I just finished up in Tucson at our rally with Mark Kelly and President Obama. I’ve gotta be honest with you, that was awesome.
#

WOW. Wow, Peter.
I just finished up in Tucson at our rally with Mark Kelly and President Obama. I’ve gotta be honest with you, that was awesome.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241018-5-160&t=1&akid=3403%2E734936%2ENdIqot)
When I first ran for Congress, I never would have expected that Arizona would become one of the most important swing states in the country. Arizona was a solid lock for the GOP back then, but we’ve made incredible progress over the last few years.
Think about it:
In 2020, we defeated Trump in Arizona and elected Senator Mark Kelly.
In 2022, we won Mark a full term and defeated Kari Lake and a whole mess of MAGA Right candidates.
In 2024, we’re going to do it again. Arizona’s congressional races are going to determine whether we take back the House. Whether we win or lose this race against Kari Lake will determine control of the Senate. And we’ve got to defeat Trump here if we’re going to defend the White House.
But the truth is, we’re running out of time. There are still a TON of undecided voters here in Arizona, and if we don’t make the most of every day and reach as many of them as we possibly can we could be looking at President Trump and Senator Kari Lake.
This is serious, and that’s why Mark and President Obama joined me on stage today. They know how close Arizona is, and we’ve got a lot of work to do to win.

clean_body: | | | I hate to reach out so late on a Friday, Peter, but this is urgent: Montanans are already heading to the polls. **** Give me a minute to explain why this fight is personal to me, Peter. ## Father, Son Charged in School Shooting
A Georgia grand jury has [indicted father and son](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD-v4yAQxD8N7rBg8R-5oMjp5C5XXHFXWhjW9uZhiIDE8rd_cvpXrFYzI400v__36W7IU1j_mB11WeIEAhouBZfD5Az5c2oqpxdEQFWhlj0MSinZqWrT2MOMc7_0rlNCqaEbZtOBFba1AkF2FemrTQo5fE7WLTSzdcp2LZp2noE1Ah2VmOpHpFA2XPwZ35hqG_fK662UZ2bqxmBkMB7HUe85XBmDEQN_ZQZjwON6NtGODMYVY1rJ8Gy3GD3PW4yFwsoXUzZM3ATHcwzcRk_ho2z0ha_JnJyCI1vQ8fm8jOD445VOBqNJ_HaTOcevv0yN0ZJj6vevCxoe-R-mZ5W0ex7kPeWuZ41Yd0P-s6H8xPSt4TsAAP__CxR7Zw) Colin and Colt Gray for the mass shooting at Apalachee High School, which resulted in four deaths and multiple injuries. Fourteen-year-old Colt Gray has been [charged as an adult](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2KwzAQhJ9G7mT045-4UHGNu1x7pVlLa2mPjRVkEZO3P5z-ihkGBj6G-bkvdyCmPX7DA13d8mKU6aRWUk9LAOL30jXBbYgGbYNOj2ay1urBNsmpUfl-9CF42Kye1Bhu2o8aB9Sw4W1qyF00rfT0kW57060-WD_0CP26GtEpDFRzaX8z7TXhxu_8wtL6_GjYpVqfh7BfwszCzOd5tn49djyPqxdmvqIwMzBjxCAj5hIJJDyBwSdEmSgmefiUM8sj5VyxyA1qwiJ95nAZ7TIWeMsdT-kTlIgXsikuPE9ipmMYRafiA4g_q-p_L72c-QsAAP__1-hsmQ) with four counts of felony murder and faces a total of 55 charges, including malice murder and aggravated assault, for the September shooting. Colin Gray, the father, purchased the gun and gave it to his son as a Christmas gift. Colin was [charged with 29 counts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O4yAUhZ8Gd1hwwXZcUGzjLttuafFzbe4OgciQWHn7UaJppzjSJx3p6Oj7d12vlhLl_a-9oWlbWUGA5lJwOa_BUnqtugtmQwRUHRo5wayUkqPqohGT9BfYwggg5BzQXbTTfhrCrN0FBt-Rea9JIedPZD-Adj4oPw5oB-eAaYGBWjn6_4Vyi7ilV3ni0fty65KJrd0rU38YLAyW8zz77HzGs757BssbGSyPyn-oIWZeH_WOvvHNtogHpxzINwx8x3LsZHmkPfLqYymJ11hKo7zzL0oJA9f88NnKaRQwdocJ95NSojpOTIv9Zil9nrXfTD0NfAcAAP__wUpslg), including second-degree murder, second-degree cruelty to children, involuntary manslaughter, and reckless conduct. In the state of Georgia, parents can be held criminally responsible for their children's actions.
## Report: Consumer Demand is Strong
Post-pandemic [demand for consumer goods](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGupiAUhJ9Gu2MEVO5fUGxjd7fd0oCMygbBAGp8-839d7e8xcnJZCaTfPPrc_rUzruw_tQ7VFnixFveEWuJvSarnX-mrrZqAThEDcUkfwkh2CDqTUm8ePeB4cMO6I00Ugp0pu-llFwKrWunvtpYy17vY03POzNbMQ89dG8Mr7oW1pWYmt_RhbJh8U-8kJo57rVXWylHrsSPio8VH-_7bhZYJO0TMtKFZo1XxUfMMSTkio8hlvdfYDP9F5oMSkGiWz8UFzqDRcpFB-vCSmUDnZRpjiGfOxJZzHE_Yv4yE4p2nvKBv2Hz0BbPjC16Sy7McQf9Q2TNVnZfJ2WP23nv8iCrrl137fybpny37qX4nwAAAP__s0SAHg) remains strong, and American spending at retail stores and restaurants is rising, according to research conducted by the Federal Reserve. Inflation-adjusted [consumer spending rose](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAUhJ8GOkf-w0Dh4jbpctst0bF9DGdlbGS8QXn7VdJvMcVopNGn7-uxPIAS5fU_7GhbLIvkUjPBmZiXAJRei-6DjYgSVY9WjHJWSgmj-s0a8IKb4IZZBUAuvJZiMmiERI96cj3Z95vgYv5E3AapnQ_KmwFhcE52mmOgVurtu1BuG8b0Kk-sN1_2PtmttePs1L9O3jt5hyPjdb6nd6mNfMJO3tGXXPYX8yWfPzvWk1GOCRqVzCo2oMTOA3OgvLK1lqtt7EJIbWMOzRTn0TkY5pFj0B519JOb_KiUgthXG46LUqLTjJ3m6w6UPmjtL1VPK38DAAD__43vbOY) 3% in 2022, 2.5% in 2023, and increased at a 2.8% annual rate in the April-June quarter, despite the highest interest rates in over two decades. Middle- and high-income households have [fueled the demand for retail goods](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGupiAUhJ9Gu2MEVO5fUGxjd7fd0oCMygbBAGp8-839d7e8xcnJZCaTfPPrc_rUzruw_tQ7VFnixFveEWuJvSarnX-mrrZqAThEDcUkfwkh2CDqTUm8ePeB4cMO6I00Ugp0pu-llFwKrWunvtpYy17vY03POzNbMQ89dG8Mr7oW1pWYmt_RhbJh8U-8kJo57rVXWylHrsSPio8VH-_7bhZYJO0TMtKFZo1XxUfMMSTkio8hlvdfYDP9F5oMSkGiWz8UFzqDRcpFB-vCSmUDnZRpjiGfOxJZzHE_Yv4yE4p2nvKBv2Hz0BbPjC16Sy7McQf9Q2TNVnZfJ2WP23nv8iCrrl137fybpny37qX4nwAAAP__s0SAHg), boosted by strong gains in income, home equity, and stock market wealth. Lower-income consumers, squeezed by inflation, are spending less than pre-pandemic levels.
## 100-Year-Old Time Capsule Opened
A 100-year-old [time capsule was unveiled](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3L3DAQhH-N3O1hfdw5LlRcCO7elElp9LG2N8iSkeQT9--Dr3-LZQcGZpjn79f8ZShQXH-bHXVd0ix6oYD3wMfZGwrvWXVeL4gCZYeaD2KUUvKH7Da9OIl8dCN6q-5cWansMhjrfviHlUKpjvSVxns-fo7f7kJZ56V73NHcrRVM9eippnz7lyjWDZfwTi_MN5f2Luit1qMw-WRiYmJqrd32Ei-PiQkjnIWJKWK73kdvVGrK5EyASjuCM0c5A4JLsRqKFFcIWCtmWHLa4chYyGOs4FIK5FeEM76QAnowFaKplKIJ0BrBfhY8r16T4fnk5cRhZHJKjjyTv35eBLGVP5iPLmt_NAqBymNgql93Q-EzqH4H-KXF_wAAAP__4XqBqQ) at the National WWI Museum and Memorial in Kansas City, Missouri, after it was extracted from the memorial in June. According to officials, the time capsule was [buried inside the museum's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0UL2OhCAYfBrsMPChKAXF5RKSy2X3yi0NwucuFxQjuGbf_uL2V8w0k8zf7TJcbIhhuV_tjLpMaQAGDeWMcjV4G-JraCqvJ0RAUaHmHSghBJeieujRogIlWmE9-F72TeedU83EHetRiqkK-nTjjKs3eN1CMzovnGzRtuMIpGHoQ0lb_ZvCUh44xVd64la7NFdRP0pZMxEfBAwBcxxHva_h1AiYH--HKx6ZgDlDCBjOTuoImKstIS020lvaoqc3u9Evetkz7jP9tku2mX6G8qIlzEidXfMekYCRrTr38V52TBEw1ab9eoQYQ5Ydadh9tiG-q5X_rnpq-AsAAP__Ks9now) Liberty Memorial Tower in 1924, with instructions left to open the container in 100 years. The time capsule's contents were revealed during a ceremony on Wednesday. Among the objects were a copy of the U.S. Constitution, newspapers, a Bible, and a copy of the U.S. declaration of war from 1917. [You can see the unveiling here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j71uwyAURp8Gtlhw-bE8MESqvLlb1aqLBeYSU-GQYmzLb18le4dv-qRzdD6HcbAxxfvt3S5oasgjMJAXzi68G72N6Rwl9SYgAgqKhrfQCSG4FnQ2qIJjzjEpoW07L3zQyJnywbdqCjrQaJ40znj3Gm8USDd5MWmFVjkHRDL0sebS_OR4rzOGdOYdSzPlhSYz1_pYibgS6An0x3E0Z97q5vD5E-hT3JFA_zX86o_vPZ_pSkQf0NatIBFv62wLelqMfxwxpbjqlkh2W2xML0H9L3g38BcAAP__rBhYdw).

Vote Note on the Referendum, Vote Yes for Sane Election Policy

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/579982ddc563/when-we-vote-we-win-14760343?e=8763c56857)

** GO VIRAL
------------------------------------------------------------

** Send and Share this simple graphic
------------------------------------------------------------

** √ Email
------------------------------------------------------------

** √ Text
------------------------------------------------------------

** √ Social Media
------------------------------------------------------------

The Real Referendum is On Election Integrity

Vote NO to MASS MAIL-IN VOTING

Absentee voting is an important privilege for those unable to vote in person due to illness, travel, military service, or religious obligations.

However, expanding mail-in voting to everyone poses unnecessary risks to election integrity. In-person voting remains the safest, most secure way to ensure every vote is counted. Connecticut already provides a generous voting system, including 14 days of early in-person voting, making additional expansion of mail-in voting unnecessary.

It's imperative that you vote no on any referendum to expand mail-in voting in Connecticut. Read my full op-ed in the CT Mirror, and please share this vital message with every voter you know. READ OPED (https://ctmirror.org/2024/10/11/vote-down-cts-no-excuse-ballot-referendum/)

Important Observations

• Voting By Mail is the least secure way to vote

• Absentee Ballots are prone to rejection

because of human error

• Mail-in votes can be lost

• Democrats constantly abuse the Absentee Ballot Process

- over 20 cases on record with the SEEC

Voter Fraud in Connecticut overwhelming involves;

√ Absentee Ballot abuse (example, Bridgeport)

√ Political candidates and operatives (example: Wanda - allegedly)

√ Voter Fraud by mail is only caught through whistle-blowers or video evidence. (Did I mention Bridgeport yet?)

https://www.dominicforct.us

** My CT Mirror OPED
------------------------------------------------------------

I am writing to oppose the November referendum proposing a “No Excuse Absentee Ballot” system. I strongly urge you to join me in voting against HRJ 1, as it poses severe risks to fairness and election integrity. - Dominic Rapini
Read Full OPED (https://ctmirror.org/2024/10/11/vote-down-cts-no-excuse-ballot-referendum/)

** GOTV Tools - Put them to use
------------------------------------------------------------

Graphics make your message stand out. You can use the graphics provided to help voters choose absentee voting if it works best for them. Here are some ideas:

• Text Messaging: Send a graphic and include a link to order a ballot online.

• Postcards: Mail to voters over a certain age, like 75.

• Social Media: Post graphics and messages, share with friends,

and go viral.

• RTC Website: Use for illustration of these critical concepts.

• Digital Campaigns: Partner with PGS Marketing to start your campaign.

I’ve created these graphics for your absentee ballot GOTV program. Use the red button below to download high-res versions! Please share any campaigns you create! Send to dominic@dominicforct.us

I've struggled with mental health my entire life, and severe anxiety has been a demon following me at every turn in life. Mental health carried more of a stigma back then; it was hard to open up and take a stand, especially as a first-year player in the NBA. _But, that didn 't stop me from risking everything for something I believed in._

**My story is ultimately one of healing, perseverance, and redemption.**

At the time, the NBA didn't have any policies to support players' mental health. A grueling 82-game season will weigh on anyone--the best athletes in the world included. As someone who has dealt with an extreme level of anxiety growing up, being thrust onto one of the biggest stages in the world at 21 years old was challenging, to say the least. That's why I decided to speak out and open a dialogue with the NBA about mental health. It was a huge risk at the time, but one that I believed was worth it. I hoped I could help other players who were struggling get the resources they needed.

I did. Despite my speaking out resulting in a huge divide between myself and the NBA, causing me to give up my childhood dream and move over to Canada's professional basketball league, I still think it was worth it. **If I had to, I would do it all again, no questions asked. Now, the NBA has a policy for players ' mental health, and I like to think that I started the conversation to make that happen.**

But I put my name, my career, and my life on the line to stand up for myself and other players who kept silent because it was bigger than basketball.

**_Today, I have a simple message for anyone struggling with mental health, including our troops, veterans, children, and all Americans: there 's no shame in asking for help, and there's no shame in standing up for yourself. If I could do it, so can you._**

There is nothing that gets me fired up more than seeing thousands of people ready to run through a wall to get something done.
That’s what I saw yesterday in Tucson. Thousands of people showed up for our rally with President Obama and Senator Kelly, and each of them are ready to take out all the stress, all the anxiety, all the fear and put it towards knocking doors, making calls, reaching everybody we possibly can in these next seventeen days before the election.
President Obama doesn’t just show up if it isn’t important.
He knows our margins are razor thin.
He knows that if Trump’s tied or leading in Arizona it’s just as likely that Kari Lake can win, too.
He knows how tough this state is — and he knows that a huge part of it is still undecided about how they’re going to vote.
We’ve got a strategy in place to reach those people and defeat Trump and Kari Lake. But if we don’t raise what we need to execute that strategy we don’t stand a chance.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Trump has momentum. What might it mean?
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/msla-11573256?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **We are now sixteen days away from the Presidential election – and Trump seems to have momentum.**

In the all-important states of Pennsylvania, Georgia and North Carolina, Trump looks ahead of Kamala. By a whisker.

**From a policy perspective, what might a Trump victory on November 5 th mean?**
---
|
---

| **A Trump win would be bad news for the administrative state.** Talking to one of Trump’s policy people a couple of months ago, they suggested to me that in his first term Trump had been too trusting of officialdom. The 45th President had underestimated the extent to which the bureaucratic machine in Washington would try to frustrate his policy goals.

I doubt that in a second term Team Trump would let that happen again. **If Trump wins, I expect to see parts of the administrative state dismantled. **

Rumours suggest that Elon Musk would be asked to form an efficiency task force. With a ballooning national debt, perhaps Musk could reengineer government to reduce its size and costs, while improving its effectiveness?
---
|
---
_Rocket Science: Musk gets better results for less from rocket engines. Could he do the same to the federal government? _
| **Trump has explicitly committed to eliminating the federal Department of Education. **

Speaking on “Fox & Friends” yesterday, Trump reiterated the point, saying that he wanted to get “education out of Washington”. In response to a question from a student, Trump said school choice “is one of the biggest things on my platform”.

Trump went on to point out that the US currently spends more on education than many other Western countries, about $16,000 per student per year.

**Unlike some in Mississippi, Trump did not pretend that there had been some sort of education ‘miracle’. **Indeed, Trump emphasized that the education system produces poor results, despite all the money lavished upon it.

**Honesty about the true state of education is the essential first step if there is to be significant reform.**

In conservative Mississippi, we have somehow ended up with a new Education Superintendent, Lance Evans, that is anti-parent power. The other week, Evans went out of his way to attack school choice.

**How odd that in a Republican-run state we should have such an anti-school choice Education Superintendent at the moment when Trump looks likely to win the White House. **

Did the Republican leaders of our state not know Evans was anti school choice before he was appointed? Or did they know the man they were about to appoint was anti parent power, but go ahead all the same?

**A Trump victory will surely flush out the anti-school choice Republicans in states like Mississippi who have done little to advance parent power.**

It is not enough to pay lip service to school choice, yet somehow allow anti school choice officials to take the helm at the Department for Education.

Nor is it acceptable to say you want school choice, when we have only a handful of Charter Schools because those appointed to oversee the Authorized Board seem happy to say “no” to new schools.

**This kind of politics has all the integrity of WorldCom accounting. A Trump win on November 5th could have the effect of an audit.**

Time could soon be up for anti-school choice “conservatives” in states like ours.

Have an awesome weekend!

clean_body: | | | | | | Dear Friend, We are now sixteen days away from the Presidential election – and Trump seems to have momentum. In the all-important states of Pennsylvania, Georgia and North Carolina, Trump looks ahead of Kamala. By a whisker. From a policy perspective, what might a Trump victory on November 5 th mean? | | A Trump win would be bad news for the administrative state. Talking to one of Trump’s policy people a couple of months ago, they suggested to me that in his first term Trump had been too trusting of officialdom. The 45th President had underestimated the extent to which the bureaucratic machine in Washington would try to frustrate his policy goals. I doubt that in a second term Team Trump would let that happen again. If Trump wins, I expect to see parts of the administrative state dismantled. Rumours suggest that Elon Musk would be asked to form an efficiency task force. With a ballooning national debt, perhaps Musk could reengineer government to reduce its size and costs, while improving its effectiveness? | Rocket Science: Musk gets better results for less from rocket engines. Could he do the same to the federal government? | Trump has explicitly committed to eliminating the federal Department of Education. Speaking on “Fox & Friends” yesterday, Trump reiterated the point, saying that he wanted to get “education out of Washington”. In response to a question from a student, Trump said school choice “is one of the biggest things on my platform”. Trump went on to point out that the US currently spends more on education than many other Western countries, about $16,000 per student per year. Unlike some in Mississippi, Trump did not pretend that there had been some sort of education ‘miracle’. Indeed, Trump emphasized that the education system produces poor results, despite all the money lavished upon it. Honesty about the true state of education is the essential first step if there is to be significant reform. In conservative Mississippi, we have somehow ended up with a new Education Superintendent, Lance Evans, that is anti-parent power. The other week, Evans went out of his way to attack school choice. How odd that in a Republican-run state we should have such an anti-school choice Education Superintendent at the moment when Trump looks likely to win the White House. Did the Republican leaders of our state not know Evans was anti school choice before he was appointed? Or did they know the man they were about to appoint was anti parent power, but go ahead all the same? A Trump victory will surely flush out the anti-school choice Republicans in states like Mississippi who have done little to advance parent power. It is not enough to pay lip service to school choice, yet somehow allow anti school choice officials to take the helm at the Department for Education. Nor is it acceptable to say you want school choice, when we have only a handful of Charter Schools because those appointed to oversee the Authorized Board seem happy to say “no” to new schools. This kind of politics has all the integrity of WorldCom accounting. A Trump win on November 5th could have the effect of an audit. Time could soon be up for anti-school choice “conservatives” in states like ours. Have an awesome weekend! | "Forward this email to a friend!" | | Warm regards, Douglas Carswell President & CEO | | |

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Dear friend,
I have some news to share. In case you haven’t heard, early voting in Massachusetts begins today and runs through November 1.
As Secretary of State Bill Galvin reminds us, you don’t need an excuse to cast an early ballot. You can vote at any early voting location in your city or town. There is at least one early voting site within each community.
As a helpful service, your friends at Massachusetts Democratic Party HQs have put together the Top Ten Reasons to Vote Early:
10- Be the first on your block with an “I Voted” sticker.
9- Avoid the long lines on Election Day.
8- Early voting ballots come in both Plain and Pumpkin Spice.
7- Tuesdays are bad for you.
6- Really, how many leaves can you peep? Give ‘em a rest for a day.
5- Save a volunteer from having to knock your door, call or text to remind you to vote on Election Day.
4- You are now free so YOU can volunteer to knock doors, call or text people to remind them to vote on Election Day.
3- Early voting is quick and easy, so you have more time to work on that friend or relative who still “isn’t quite sure.”
2- Mom always said, no better time than the present.
And the #1 reason to vote early ...
1- When our freedoms and the future of democracy are on the line, WHY WAIT?
We encourage all Massachusetts Democrats, who are able to do so, to get out and vote early. You can find your community’s early voting schedule here. [https://www.sec.state.ma.us/EarlyVotingWeb/EarlyVotingSearch.aspx]
You can also request a mail-in ballot here [https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/voting-information/vote-by-mail.htm] any time between now and October 29th.
Voting is the most important thing we can do. But, once you do cast your early ballot, there are many other ways you can help elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, Elizabeth Warren and Democrats all down the ballot. Click the links below for some crucial volunteering opportunities:

Split a donation between the Harris Victory Fund and MassDems! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/massdemsxharris]

Get out and vote early!

name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: please don't make us choose
body:
With just about two weeks until Election Day, we're finalizing our spending decisions, and we're doing it while we're short of our budget goals.
---
Derek -- We are just about two weeks away from Election Day. We're finalizing our spending decisions, and we're doing it while we're short of our budget goals. It's not ideal, but it is where we're at. Like any good organization, every state and every race we're targeting has a budget. If we meet our goals, everything gets fully funded and Democrats have a great chance to win. If we don't meet our budget goals, we have to start deciding what states and races to pull money out of. And then it's a question of priorities. What races and states MUST we win? And where can we make sacrifices? That's where we're at right now. Unless we hit our goals. clean_body: It’s a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives—for the better. | | | Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--for the better. Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,Right Wing Revolution,as a guide for a return to an America where ... We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness. We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution. We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal. We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night. We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans. Fellow Patriot, I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before: It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right. It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American. It's NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving ourselves. I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE. In this defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to find all that's possible in the days ahead. Thank YOU for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of Turning Point USA. For America, Charlie Kirk Founder & CEO Turning Point USA 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Democrat policies had brought America to its knees.And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, “it's déjà vu all over again.”There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. Will you chip in to my campaign and Wiley to make sure we finish strong ahead of our last public filing deadline?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95359558/506464480/-1496965012?refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_TAN_AC_20241019_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYTAwM2QwOS0yMThlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XjOe61Bce0nxfLlBcunEnN-Bw_Egt-huQsT4-8N0Phs=) It’s an ambitious goal, I know, but the money we raise now could make all the difference in what happens on Election Day. body:
My interview with NBC’s Meet the Press.
#
This is a long email, but I hope you’ll take a moment to read it because it’s important.
In an interview about our historic campaign on NBC’s _Meet the Press_ , I was asked about Donald Trump’s dangerous and anti-trans political ad airing across the country, including in some areas of Delaware.
I know this is the kind of politics of division and distraction we’ll see from some in Congress.
As the nation’s first transgender state senator, I’m used to working with people who disagree with me on fundamental issues — including those that are near and dear to my heart.
**I’m not running to be _the_ transgender member of Congress; I’m running to represent Delaware and be a damn good legislator, working on all of the issues that matter.** And that means working with those who disagree with me on deeply personal issues, including LGBTQ+ equality.
_That’s exactly how I’ve passed policies in Delaware, like paid family and medical leave with bipartisan support and funding to expand, protect, and enhance Medicaid._
We can be the antidote to Donald Trump and the MAGA right’s hate and extremism and get big things done in Congress — but we have to win this race first.

Can I share something with you, friend?
I never back down from a tough fight. I was raised to put my head down and do what’s right, especially when it’s difficult. That’s the attitude I brought to my first Senate run in 2018, when I overcame the odds and flipped Nevada blue – and it continues to motivate me today.
**But I’ve never run in a race quite like this.**
Donald Trump and my opponent are dragging my name through the mud because they know that if they win Nevada, they WILL take control of the Senate and the White House.
**Even worse? Our fundraising took a total nosedive over the past 48 hours.**

You see, Debbie immigrated to America from Ecuador when she was only 14. After watching her mom work double shifts to pay the bills, Debbie got a job at the local doughnut shop.
Her minimum wage checks were small, but they helped make ends meet. Eventually, that doughnut shop job made it possible for her to put herself through college, pursue a career of service, and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress.
Now, Debbie is running for Senate against a megamillionaire who spent $64 MILLION of his own money to buy this seat last time around. But she’s not scared.

Happy Saturday, Peter!! With just three weekends left to reach voters before Election Day, our team is pounding the pavement across NJ-02!
Our mission is to connect with every voter in South Jersey, but that also means we have to increase our budget to ensure we have the funds we need to:
🚪 Pay for door-knocking literature
🍽 Fuel our volunteers with snacks and water
📋 Hire the best field organizers to get out the vote

#

Peter —
I’m going to keep this quick.
I was at a rally in Tucson yesterday with President Obama and my buddy Ruben because we’ve got to mobilize every single voter we possibly can over the next 17 days.
[**To do that, and to win in Arizona, I need you to make a donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign. Not next week. Not tomorrow. Right now. Please, chip in.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241019-2-160&t=1&akid=3405%2E734936%2EK6rLMk)

Anywhere from 5-10% of the voters here are still making up their minds. That’s more than enough to swing the result, so we’ve got to move fast and make our case to them. And most of Arizona is going to vote early — around 80% will cast their ballots by November 1st.

But none of that happens if Ruben can’t raise the resources he needs to finish this race strong.

Peter,

**The OG Emerge woman, Kamala Harris, is breaking records!**

In a historic milestone, the Harris campaign raised $1 billion since entering the Presidential race – _an achievement no other presidential candidate accomplished._

While we’re celebrating this milestone, this is a great opportunity for you to contribute to Emerge. The Harris-Walz campaign understands the importance of winning at the state and local levels to fully enact their agenda. _**Emerge and our alums are right at the center of this effort.**_

## Paxton Sues Doc for Giving Hormones to Minors
Attorney General Ken Paxton [sued Dallas doctor](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGvpCAUBeBfgx0GUAYpKLaxe9tuaa7cq0OCYIAZn_9-86Z_5clJvpycf1_LF4QY0v4XDnLte8uLEmrkUnBpF4QQ72Xs0K0CrezISaPsoKWwtns6sQ3Cw2qNBCOnQY-jMWoQ6L19PMDKLrgfTApppZaTsD2Q0bgiaK031MPARkEYWi59e1Kjb6hbvPObSu_z0UX3bO2sbPjD1MzUfF1Xn1af6Ko_PVNzWj3Pr8bUnF-NnzmGFnzlkPAT_M3U_GE57Ly-qHLMvuXCIUbaCePNz5LfAQl5K5DqTgmpcA-FuJL8CCmXyotPII2209QVh-cVYgz1Ydgo9gNC_Ixtv773dup_AAAA__8BJXRL) May Lau for providing hormone replacement treatments to 21 minors. This is a key case tied to Senate Bill 14, which bans such treatments for youth. Paxton, who is seeking $1 million plus civil penalties, [said in a statement](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LvOnDAQBeCngc7IFy7rwkUauj9tSjTsDGDF2MieH5a3j3aVlOmm-Obo6Pz6mr7ABx_Xn7CT49eSJi11K5QUyk4IPtxTW6ObJVpVk1ODtqZT0tp6c_o5oOkfVi6z6Rc0s31gD7CYtpdWoa69e4cpqazq1EPaBmjocEboum7BzpiqlYSeU254I6YXlCXc6aTcPNNeB7cxH6UyPyo9Vnq8rqv5IGBOOdK9UqQMoVnTWekx0lUqPWYKBIXe5z8n_kLxm6I44MUpivJNRWB6csrCh0ArhHCLI6fTo4-r2CDvy3d4vyJlwRli8exTFJwJeKfIpc4Oj8uH4Es_VK1cd_DhU53_u-Xp9J8AAAD__9O7fZM), “ _Doctors who continue to provide these harmful ‘gender transition’ drugs and treatments will be prosecuted to the full extent of the law._ " The lawsuit claims that Dr. Lau, a pediatrician at UT Southwestern Medical Center in Dallas, prescribed testosterone to patients [between the ages of 14 and 17](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j71uwyAURp8Gb1j8mGAGhi7e0rWjdWMuCSoBC0hw3r5K9u7fd47Oz3k9Q4ghXb_hjrYdPq-CiYlyRrlZHYT4WqfB2Qtzhg9ouRZGKs6MGW72pGE2ILWSGzfS-40ZB3zWME9eaBRDsG8YZ9xwxWdmRkCt3MWBUso7JSWZGLrQchnbDRseUH185SeWccv3Idpba3sl8ouIhYil9z76fGh41BbSe0LEkrBXIpbPmbYCqV4xOSx0g4I0Qq-P0OgvJrrD0XIainV7DzGGetJkYtc7hPjRtX_7n1b8BQAA__93jF8-). If found guilty, Dr. Lau could lose her medical license.
## No. 1 Longhorns vs No. 5 Bulldogs Today
The top-ranked Texas Longhorns (6-0) take on the No. 5 Georgia Bulldogs (5-1) at home today (6:30 p.m. Central on ABC). It’s their first meeting since the 2019 Sugar Bowl, which Texas won 28-21. Texas, [favored by 5 points at press time](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL_OpCAUxZ8Gu2sAQaWg2MZutt3SoPfqkGGEABln3n7jlF_ytScnv_Pn322-OR_8sf91T7L1vcVZcqlAcBBmRufDZ1YN2oWjEQ1ZMUjTacGNae7WKBxH5XQvVd8jF84MwyCMQn4pJBpvL5jgwggtRm5aR4PGBZ3WekPddUxxQl9jbuudKr1d2cInvii3a3w2wd5rTYV1f5icmJzO82zXpZQUcy2Xg8lpjSHQTrDFWBcXApPTQWdhctop5t07eBX4kiFlQr9WHw-IiAVKyuQQgj8IvqN_siD59VHgJHrACPROlCukHBMsVK-IJltMpw_Bl35giu9P58O3ev31y5eV_wMAAP__MqN5Gg), is coming off a 34-3 drubbing of the Oklahoma Sooners last week in the Red River Shootout, while Georgia has been perfect aside from a close loss to Alabama in Week 5. The highly-anticipated match provides the Longhorns with their first major test since joining the Southeastern Conference this year.
## 1,500-Mile Adventure Trail to Open
A [1,500-mile Texas adventure trail](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHSoyAURp8GOxxA0VBQbGOXbbd0rnCJd5aAo3ejefudpP_77ztz5vy5z3egTOXxG57o-Up1Nsr0Uiup3RyB8nvum-gXFZ1u0OvRuM5q5Vyzejug0WlJtxFj0DhqM3RpuQ2jGay1YBvyH5hW2mmrb8q1gKONSwRrbYq260SvMBLXveUVGS84Un7XF-5tqM8m-5V5O0T3S5hJmOk8zzbVywxr_XdwLZ-RMFPB8xBm-t4l70BZrvSXykNefEnYNsgQVoIiNwiUKMiw48Ey1MJUsDBkGelFEZvdx-2knOkYRtGrxxMof1X4xzYvb_4HAAD__8cMacY) for hikers, bikers, and horseback riders is expected to open next spring. Stretching [from Orange to El Paso](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0ULFugzAU_BrYjJ5tHPDgoUu2dO2IHvEjPMXgyHaB_H1FO3e6053udLqv23BDDrw-PnEhV44pDgpUKyQIaQePHN5DW3s3greyJic7ZbWRYG09O-rB4F1rO7a2992kbQ8XoOkCSG0vbc3uLJMgrTSyB9sgdcaPHo0xkzdaVy2Q5xJTU2YqdGCewjtulJp7XOrg5lJeudIflbpW6rrvezPFY6U9n36lriXhRuEkZ1YsuApeN1pLFlKYp1g4kEB_Kt-JREnIQcz8pJTF-AdzTJlGvD9FYk8p18n5184hcL50VQuPBTn8zin__rM59RMAAP__I3Vqrg) and traversing the Hill Country, the Big Bend, and Guadalupe Peak, the _Cross Texas Trail_ , or XTX, is being developed by former state representative Charlie Gandy and the group _Bike Texas_. The preliminary route, which employs gravel back roads and one-lane highways, is currently being tested. Gandy's [ambitious vision for the XTX](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GO6yAQheGngc4RMzZ2KChu4y633dKCDNizwSbCJOu8_Srptz7Sd_R_XaaL48Tb_N-twdYj5gkVdg2oBsxEjtNr6iRZr8iADBYGNK0GZYxcLMHg-74P4COhVy2iifqqBtAafDw7yfaNgQIDGs7KnFwYNHlyWutIum1FpwJxzeVUl1DD4faYXvkZyumaV5nsUut9F-0_gaPAcQ6ufD-2G4f3LHDMj0o5F4HjwjfeZoHjteR9bz5UU4vj1Bz1kMXS_YdT4r0fRKfm1XH6XNQ_m58WfwMAAP__749aaw) is to rival the famed Appalachian, Pacific Crest, and Continental Divide trails. _"For a lot of Texans, it 's a point of pride. All we're doing is harnessing the energy of that point of pride and turning it into something that we can share,"_ said Gandy.

| | Peter, Iowans are casting their ballots _right now_ to decide who will represent our district in Congress — and this race couldn’t be closer. We have just a couple of weeks left until the election, and we have the chance to flip one of the most competitive districts across the nation. IA-03 will determine who controls the House, so we need every single vote to take this seat back. name: GIFFORDS
subject: Women deserve to live with freedom from domestic violence

body:
October is Domestic Violence Awareness Month
#

_We’d like to let you know that the email below discusses domestic violence. If this is not something you’d like to read about today, please click away._
_If you or someone you love is in danger, please know that you are not alone. There are resources available to you. Call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233 or text “START” to 88788 to be connected with an advocate._
* * *
Friends -
October is Domestic Violence Awareness Month. As we continue our work towards a future free from gun violence, Domestic Violence Awareness Month serves as a solemn reminder of the connection between guns and domestic violence in our nation.
Firearms are used to commit over half of intimate partner homicides in the United States. Although anyone can be impacted by domestic violence, women are three times more likely to be killed by an abusive partner. Every year, more than 600 American women are shot and killed by intimate partners—roughly one every 14 hours.
Earlier this year, the Supreme Court upheld the federal law that prohibits people subject to domestic violence restraining orders from possessing guns. Although we were disheartened that this decades-long standard was challenged in the first place, we were glad that women’s safety prevailed.
But the work is far from over. Gun lobby extremists will stop at nothing to chip away at our laws protecting women from domestic violence. We must continue on together in our advocacy and legislative work to ensure that individual states pass legislation that prohibits domestic abusers from having access to guns.
[**In honor of Domestic Violence Awareness Month, will you sign on to say that you support women’s right to live with freedom from domestic violence?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_dvam_pet_oct24/?source=em241019-1-60&refcode2=9237.3935704.COUR1b&akid=9237%2E3935704%2ECOUR1b)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_dvam_pet_oct24/?source=em241019-1-60&refcode2=9237.3935704.COUR1b&akid=9237%2E3935704%2ECOUR1b)**
Thank you so much for using your voice today.
\- The team at GIFFORDS

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=9237%2E3935704%2ECOUR1b) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

name: David Hogg
subject: Deeply worried about us
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241019&t=1&akid=1334%2E587540%2EF0rI9s)
Hey Peter – thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important.
**You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place.** Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker (multiple times). The Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like mass shootings happening nearly every day because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an _even greater_ and _more long-term threat_ \- **hopelessness.**
When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections last year, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work.
I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better.
**We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan.** A group of us launched Leaders We Deserve last summer. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark and Molly Cook, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them.
For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business.
**The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers.** The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate.
**We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation.**
Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

**Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically.** Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve.
**But what we do _right now_ will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass.** We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country.
* * *
**Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work.**
– If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. **[Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241019?refcode=em20241019-1334&amount=500&refcode2=1334_587540_F0rI9s&akid=1334%2E587540%2EF0rI9s)**
– If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. **[Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that).](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241019?refcode=em20241019-1334&amount=25&recurring=true&refcode2=1334_587540_F0rI9s&akid=1334%2E587540%2EF0rI9s)**
– If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). **[Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241019?refcode=em20241019-1334&refcode2=1334_587540_F0rI9s&akid=1334%2E587540%2EF0rI9s)**
– Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause.
* * *
**I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change.**
If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today.
David Hogg

clean_body: Unless we organize like never before, the billions that corporate elites are pouring into Pennsylvania could tip the scales in Trump’s favor. | | | We just HAD to re-send this email to you, Peter, because the news is alarming. You can read the full email below, but here’s a quick recap: Elon Musk already spent a whopping $75 million on Trump’s campaign in just the last three months. And now he’s personally hosting a series of town halls all across Pennsylvania. In solidarity, Team WFP \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Working Families Party Date: Thu, Oct 17, 2024 at 2:43PM Subject: Elon Musk is circling Pennsylvania To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Pennsylvania is the biggest battleground of 2024, Peter — and right-wing billionaires are circling it like vultures. Yesterday, Elon Musk announced he’ll be holding a series of talks across the state every night this week.1 This announcement comes just weeks after his first rally with Donald Trump, where he literally jumped for joy on stage in Butler, Pennsylvania, proudly calling himself “dark MAGA.”2 But that’s not all. Musk's America PAC just filed its latest FEC report, revealing that he’s poured an eye-popping $75 million into Trump’s campaign over just the last three months.3 With your $10 contribution, we can: 📚 Print 32 pieces of literature 📞 Make 29 calls to voters 🚀 Boost canvassing and staff capacity 🌟 Elect Kamala Harris and Working Families Party champions up and down the ballot in Pennsylvania and other swing states. Meanwhile, Musk has also turned Twitter — now rebranded as X — into a pro-MAGA misinformation machine.4 Despite the platform losing 80% of its value since he bought it for $44 billion,5 Musk is willing to take that hit, hoping that his real payout will come if Trump and insurrectionist Republicans regain full control of the levers of powers in D.C. And Musk isn’t the only one bankrolling Republicans in Pennsylvania this election. 2024’s largest election donor Jeffrey Yass and other billionaire elites are funneling mountains of cash to prop up their corporate, anti-union, special interest agenda. But that’s where the Working Families Party comes in. We’re on the ground in Pennsylvania and key battleground states across the country, pushing back with people power. We’re organizing not just for Harris and Walz, but also for key champions like Senator Bob Casey, Malcolm Kenyatta, Eugene DePasquale, and Rep. Summer Lee — all fighting for working families. And every district and state we can win for these candidates will help Kamala Harris win on Election Day. Peter, we may not have the billions of our opponents — but we can out-organize them at the doors, on the phones, and through real conversations with voters. http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsbY3pfWlN

Do you look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest
and most interesting conservatives each month?

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osbY3pfWlN

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

Are you
enjoying your Imprimis subscription?

Do you
look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most
interesting conservatives each month?

I hope
so.

You will
never have to pay for Imprimis because we want its message in
defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many
citizens as possible.

We're
grateful that you read Imprimis, and we hope you share your copy
with others after you've read it-and that you encourage others
you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale
relies on a nationwide network of supporters-people like you-to
help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government,
free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and
strong national defense.

You're a
longtime Imprimis subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how
the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our
country.

And you
understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to
undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate
the American people about our founding principles of
liberty…the importance of reviving limited constitutional
government…the need to defend the rule of law…and
the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free
enterprise.

That's
why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale
College.

Other
colleges and universities have fallen prey to moral and cultural
relativism and the oppression of "political
correctness"-Hillsdale has not-and it continues to fulfill its
mission of defending civil and religious liberty through
education.

Will you
help?

In
addition to sending Imprimis to more Americans, you will help
us…

Teach
Americans of all ages who wish to learn about the Declaration of
Independence, the Constitution, free-market economics, American
Heritage, the Great Books, and more through free online courses
(to date, more than 4 million students have registered for one or
more courses);

Launch and support dozens more classical K-12 schools
nationwide-schools where students receive an education rooted in
the liberal arts and sciences and learn the importance of moral
character and civic virtue. More than 15,000 students currently
attend over 90 Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools, and thousands
more are on waiting lists.

Your
support is especially needed today because Hillsdale College does
not accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in
the form of federal or state student grants and loans. We refuse
to allow the government to interfere with our internal affairs.

So, we
rely on the support of informed patriots like you, who understand
the importance of education to liberty.

Whatever
amount you give today, whether it's…

>> $25
>> $35
>> $50
>> $100
>> $250

…will help us defend the freedom of the American people
and the American way of life through education.

Simply
click the link below and let us know if we can count on your
support.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63639346:sbY3pfWlN:m:3:2627245898:B0194B8E984B184E226403547F5FE41F:r

Thank you
in advance for your help in reaching and teaching millions more
Americans on behalf of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter,

It’s Joanna McClinton, Speaker of the Pennsylvania State House. I’ve been proud to champion progressive legislation and fight for change for all — not just the wealthy and well-connected at the top.

But before I was the first woman to serve as Speaker of the House, House Democratic Leader, or House Democratic Caucus Chair, I was a public defender. I saw firsthand what a dire lack of community resources and an out-of-touch justice system was doing to our neighbors. My experiences and those around me shaped my values — integrity, equity, compassion, and putting people first — which inspired me to begin my career as a public defender, eventually leading me to where I am today.

In 2022, we flipped the Pennsylvania State House for the first time in over a decade — and I’ve carried those same values with me every step of the way. With our majority, House Democrats have focused on workers and their families, better and more equitable education, accessible and affordable health care, and building a better, brighter future.

This November, all eyes will be on Pennsylvania and control of the State House will be decided on the margins. Defending our slim majority in the House (and keeping Pennsylvania blue!) is going to take a lot of resources, so I’m working to build a grassroots coalition to help us hold the House! Will you join our team of supporters by making a contribution today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JMPA-HD191-Email-ONB2024-FR-Onb?&refcode=E7935-2024-Onb3-SL-PersonalFromPrinciple&amount=25]

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. Our goal is to provide 34 boxes of diapers to every state.**

Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=ffec2d41029d40f3a828b58b2bd69740&_e=WLtMroykPDyM3yzKIPN0Z8NMta3UjD9H_BUR5GvLs3sGd8XsiNzeimI2M1fXBgIcvKsRO0V50kKZ1aARvkIrtFJcd6fI9k9MOmF37uBvSG2GO9FF1g6QzF1d7mq51T6T9ecgBmh1DVgyFEyXQ7v5FgN_CB9UYxL7wDLI4-JEJCh67u_yCyncwzR3UEWayN2tQWRhnfun2jb-dSjW8w25pfyDCwCDKSITwWDE6V5rwiL-f96-DnIP4sy-29kroLA6Oz16zsrjjTyWSytfEeC5bZUVehTHLmDM7WeL0vNiF3WtBEMn6FT3cqY8mWQJ0UUaxEpy3fMqiQDVt3JtCSiuI7JMjHBUJypI_j4jX3GWMDfT9-7Aof7TQJprp7goTQ7OkhI6SrFNrxcBBNjGFomRyA%3D%3D)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: “The greatest I Voted sticker ever designed"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friends,
This May, I launched a competition to design Michigan’s “I Voted” stickers. I was blown away with the quality of the submissions - nearly 500 of them. The enthusiasm and creativity were off the charts.

And then, after over 50,000 Michiganders voted to choose their favorite design, Last Week Tonight’s John Oliver deemed one of them - the brilliant design from our Elementary/Middle School winner, Jane from Grosse Pointe - “the greatest sticker ever designed.”

https://www.instagram.com/p/DBJtj99yaw-/ [https://www.instagram.com/p/DBJtj99yaw-/]
Early voting in person starts TODAY in Detroit (October 19th)! So we’re going to start seeing tons of these stickers in the wild. We’ve got plenty - but if you want to get yours by voting early, visit https://www.michigan.gov/vote [https://www.michigan.gov/vote]

With nearly a million Michiganders (and counting) having already cast their ballots this year, we’ve been hard at work making sure every eligible citizen’s vote is counted. As we get closer to Election Day, I’ll send you more updates about our work – and reminders for you to share with your friends and neighbors to make sure they go vote, too.

-Jocelyn

PS: John Oliver did his whole show on election subversion and what to expect after Election Night is worth a watch - you can check it out here [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CkK3W0lOKcc] .

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: The FTC just issued a huge win for working people
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
For too long, companies have tricked consumers when it comes to recurring payments. Not anymore.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2376%2E4032634%2EbYMnd1)
---
Have you ever had to jump through multiple hoops just to cancel a gym membership — maybe jumping more than you ever had at the gym? We’ve all been there, trying to simply cancel a recurring subscription — after we finally find it buried in our account settings — and being told we can’t cancel unless we chat with an agent. Or call someone. Or write a letter. Or go to a physical location. For too long, companies have tricked consumers when it comes to recurring payments. Either making what they’re signing up for unclear, making it intentionally difficult to cancel, or a mix of both. Not anymore. This week, the FTC adopted a “click-to-cancel” rule, requiring businesses to make it as easy to cancel a subscription as it is to sign up for one. It’s simple: Businesses can’t force customers to cancel a subscription using a method different from how they signed up. This new rule also requires businesses to receive customer consent before they are charged, and it covers free trials that charge you if you don’t cancel in time. Companies that break this rule can be liable for civil penalties. [**This is just one more way the Biden-Harris Administration is using the power of government to crack down on greedy corporations and lower costs for families. Please add your name here to say you support the FTC’s new proposed rule.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-click-to-cancel-rule/?source=EMZ23H_FTC_E_20241019_V1S1&t=8&akid=2376%2E4032634%2EbYMnd1) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-click-to-cancel-rule/?source=EMZ23H_FTC_E_20241019_V1S1&t=9&akid=2376%2E4032634%2EbYMnd1)
---
This new rule is part of how we take on the entrenched power of giant corporations, which have boosted their profits through deceitful tactics that hurt consumers. It shouldn’t be this way.
Look: It’s no accident that the FTC is taking this bold action right now. President Biden appointed a terrific FTC chair, Lina Khan. And she’s been part of the administration’s pro-worker, pro-consumer team — unafraid to take on tough fights with powerful interests.
I’m proud to be in the fight to take on greedy corporations — and I’m fired up to achieve more wins like this one for working people.
Let’s make sure this new rule withstands opposition from greedy corporations that want to keep tricking consumers to line their pockets.
[**If you’re on board with the FTC’s click to cancel rule, add your name.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-click-to-cancel-rule/?source=EMZ23H_FTC_E_20241019_V1S1&t=10&akid=2376%2E4032634%2EbYMnd1)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

clean_body: For too long, companies have tricked consumers when it comes to recurring payments. Not anymore. | | | Have you ever had to jump through multiple hoops just to cancel a gym membership — maybe jumping more than you ever had at the gym? We’ve all been there, trying to simply cancel a recurring subscription — after we finally find it buried in our account settings — and being told we can’t cancel unless we chat with an agent. Or call someone. Or write a letter. Or go to a physical location. For too long, companies have tricked consumers when it comes to recurring payments. Either making what they’re signing up for unclear, making it intentionally difficult to cancel, or a mix of both. Not anymore. This week, the FTC adopted a “click-to-cancel” rule, requiring businesses to make it as easy to cancel a subscription as it is to sign up for one. It’s simple: Businesses can’t force customers to cancel a subscription using a method different from how they signed up. This new rule also requires businesses to receive customer consent before they are charged, and it covers free trials that charge you if you don’t cancel in time. Companies that break this rule can be liable for civil penalties. | This new rule is part of how we take on the entrenched power of giant corporations, which have boosted their profits through deceitful tactics that hurt consumers. It shouldn’t be this way. Look: It’s no accident that the FTC is taking this bold action right now. President Biden appointed a terrific FTC chair, Lina Khan. And she’s been part of the administration’s pro-worker, pro-consumer team — unafraid to take on tough fights with powerful interests. I’m proud to be in the fight to take on greedy corporations — and I’m fired up to achieve more wins like this one for working people. Let’s make sure this new rule withstands opposition from greedy corporations that want to keep tricking consumers to line their pockets. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Trump’s return to Detroit
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2102%2E135344%2EW_VLru)

Yesterday, Donald Trump came back to Detroit. He held three separate events, including a rally alongside my opponent, Mike Rogers, just a week after repeatedly insulting Detroit and Detroiters.
He — once again — insulted the city of Detroit, repeated lies about Vice President Harris, and fearmongered about members of our community. He also repeatedly sang praises of my opponent, Mike Rogers. Rogers returned the favor.
But the bigger message was not Trump’s words — it’s his actions. Trump’s repeated presence here in Michigan over and over and over again is the clearest signal of all.
And at the very same time as Trump was on stage, Vice President Kamala Harris was wrapping up the third in a series of rallies across Michigan. She is campaigning here today and will return later in the week.
And while Michigan has been in the national political spotlight before, this feels unprecedented.
But it all — the repeated visits from both presidential candidates, along with a slew of other celebrities and leaders, the phone calls and texts, the endless political ads — comes down to this: This election, and with it the future of our country, will be decided by what happens here in Michigan.
And Trump knows it too: If he loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
That’s why Republicans are throwing everything they can at Michigan: Outside groups have already spent or committed more than $50 million in TV ads attacking me and propping up Mike Rogers.
And our state is virtually tied — recent public polls show a dead heat for both the presidential and the Senate race, Cook Political Report has our race rated as a pure toss-up, and the nonpartisan election forecasters have said there may be no state more important in the presidential race than Michigan.
The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day.
[**We can't let that happen. Want to help? Chip in what you can and help send a message that Michigan is sure as hell not ready to swing back to Trump.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241020-2&t=2&akid=2102%2E135344%2EW_VLru)

He held three separate events, including a rally alongside my opponent, Mike Rogers, just a week after repeatedly insulting Detroit and Detroiters. Hi Peter, it's Ken Burns.
I am in the business of history. I’ve spent my life learning about America’s past and understanding the challenges our democratic system of government has faced. From Ben Franklin to Gettysburg, Pennsylvania has always played a critical role in shaping our democracy -- and it has the chance to do so again this year.
[**That’s why I’m personally asking you to help keep Bob Casey in the Senate. Bob is running to protect voting rights and our democratic institutions -- and his success will make the difference in who has control of the Senate majority.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241019-2?refcode=em20241019-2&recurring=1&refcode2=4613_552475_irzor-&akid=4613%2E552475%2Eirzor-)

body:
Here’s how we’re mobilizing voters for climate champions everywhere.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95379394/506527484/1328794144?refcode=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRmNmZhYWNhLTM4OGUtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DBji-VNaVVVN3gdAzw9qDyXZDjTH2XOcY0ROKJUDONw=&emci=cd4c507a-908d-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=4823105)
---
We’re just 17 days out from one of the most important elections of our lives, and I’m all in. Over the last few weeks, I’ve been crisscrossing the country. I’ve been to Michigan, California, New Mexico, Arizona, and Washington State — talking to voters, rallying volunteers, and raising funds to support Vice President Kamala Harris and JanePAC’s slate of down-ballot climate candidates. And I’m not slowing down any time soon. I’m doing everything I can to build momentum for the climate movement — and I’m not alone. _Everywhere_ I go, I meet people who feel the urgency of this moment for our planet, and I can tell how much hope and energy there is for real change. **[But hope alone doesn’t win elections. That’s why we need to keep this work going until every last vote is cast. Will you chip in $17 today, so JanePAC can keep up our organizing work for the next 17 days?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95379395/506527485/2105508926?amount=17&refcode=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRmNmZhYWNhLTM4OGUtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DBji-VNaVVVN3gdAzw9qDyXZDjTH2XOcY0ROKJUDONw=)** | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95379396/506527486/2105508926?refcode=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRmNmZhYWNhLTM4OGUtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DBji-VNaVVVN3gdAzw9qDyXZDjTH2XOcY0ROKJUDONw=) | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95379397/506527487/2105508926?refcode=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRmNmZhYWNhLTM4OGUtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DBji-VNaVVVN3gdAzw9qDyXZDjTH2XOcY0ROKJUDONw=)

The enthusiasm on the ground is something I wish every single one of you could see.
I’ve been hitting the road, showing up at phone banks where dedicated volunteers are making calls to urge as many people as possible to vote with climate in their hearts before polls close on Election Day. I’ve spoken at fundraisers, encouraging people to dig deep and give what they can to support Kamala Harris and our down-ballot climate champions. And I’ve been at local canvass kickoffs, cheering on the volunteers who are out there on the doors, spreading the word about candidates who are fighting for a livable planet.
**This is how we win: with passion, persistence, and a whole lot of teamwork.**
Together, we can elect climate champions up and down the ballot, and then get straight to work demanding that they commit to a fossil-fuel-free future.
**[If you can, will you chip in to help us keep mobilizing climate voters across the country? Your support means we can keep canvassers knocking on doors, phone bankers making calls, and voters turning out for climate champions.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95379398/506527488/2105508926?refcode=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.4f6faaca-388e-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRmNmZhYWNhLTM4OGUtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DBji-VNaVVVN3gdAzw9qDyXZDjTH2XOcY0ROKJUDONw=)**

clean_body: Here’s how we’re mobilizing voters for climate champions everywhere. | We’re just 17 days out from one of the most important elections of our lives, and I’m all in. Over the last few weeks, I’ve been crisscrossing the country. I’ve been to Michigan, California, New Mexico, Arizona, and Washington State — talking to voters, rallying volunteers, and raising funds to support Vice President Kamala Harris and JanePAC’s slate of down-ballot climate candidates. And I’m not slowing down any time soon. I’m doing everything I can to build momentum for the climate movement — and I’m not alone. Everywhere I go, I meet people who feel the urgency of this moment for our planet, and I can tell how much hope and energy there is for real change. = | = | = ---|--- The enthusiasm on the ground is something I wish every single one of you could see. I’ve been hitting the road, showing up at phone banks where dedicated volunteers are making calls to urge as many people as possible to vote with climate in their hearts before polls close on Election Day. I’ve spoken at fundraisers, encouraging people to dig deep and give what they can to support Kamala Harris and our down-ballot climate champions. And I’ve been at local canvass kickoffs, cheering on the volunteers who are out there on the doors, spreading the word about candidates who are fighting for a livable planet. This is how we win: with passion, persistence, and a whole lot of teamwork. Together, we can elect climate champions up and down the ballot, and then get straight to work demanding that they commit to a fossil-fuel-free future. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for being part of this journey with me. I look forward to celebrating with you after November 5th. But for now, we’re on the road again! 🚗 Onward, Jane Fonda = P.S. If you’re looking for a different way to get involved, we’d love to have you join our team of volunteers! name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: these students are unstoppable!
body:
Dear Peter,

What gives me the most hope for the future isn’t in D.C. . . .

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/13DK3onczkVxJIpTnFxhcg~~/AAVkMwA~
. . . but on the streets of Phoenix, Arizona!

Despite some students traveling up to 12 hours to get there, our canvassers managed to knock on 23,000 doors!

And they did it all during a record heat wave!

Students for Life Action recently canvassed neighborhoods across Phoenix to inform voters about the deadly Proposition 139, an extreme referendum that would allow abortion through all nine months of pregnancy for any reason.

Our door-knockers understand all too well what’s at stake in November, not just in Arizona, but for the entire nation.

That’s why they gave it their all, talking to as many people as possible about why they should
"Vote No to Proposition 139!"
– even when it wasn't easy.

One of our student canvassers, Juan, encountered a confrontational man who even cursed at him for being pro-life.

Juan remained calm, polite, and even eventually convinced him to vote NO on Arizona’s radical abortion referendum, Proposition 139!

Another student, Tanner, educated a pro-abortion woman about the evils of Proposition 139.

Even though she was at first hesitant, Tanner helped build common ground, shared the facts, and the woman was so shocked that she changed her mind and would vote against it.

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/A1RjDfonLoHdj_4_fVPLMw~~/AAVkMwA~

There were also many people who were excited to see and even thanked our students for educating voters about the truth of Proposition 139.

One woman even told our student, Hilary, that we are doing the Lord’s work.

Peter, I couldn’t be prouder of students like Juan, Tanner, and Hilary.

Their passion to protect preborn Life is infectious, and they are turning hearts and minds against abortion.

Because at the end of the day, the Pro-Life Movement is really about creating a Culture of Life.

And that begins when we make sure that every preborn boy and girl has the guaranteed liberty to Life.

I can only pray that more students will choose to take such a courageous stand, and that they will inspire voters to follow their lead.

And Peter, I want to thank you for all you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action
