Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=34acc68fef714759866e933098218990&_e=Cdn9b8fsqU5Vt2Y1h2FoQ2i-bkhh0UaDqKOHQzl1-JrvhOyl3c4OcgeW9Ri2QOtBoCBvFXApxeysyq5Z-K-hna-hdFz_KOKJK4kFjJnVrbNi5oxBfgJx20g48enKvP4MsYjjM6fAdZWBJAu47g8w2G-eOAsFbIcXU87zxY6yrIF53-A4FXgECwdWiZL1Q5RgzzafaxwZeuBPIDdIyM55IGtMgCrb84K2tI82jYJqmkHX2__S406hcirx0Is_1KFnnxzKsf8FzsaWEmz3y3fVk3zUv0RUxrnQv_AD-EPVu-LW0WBK44e2ne_u9Q6ZRf1i5XXKKNWZ8fza-5NaaL40MgtCCq5lHFOB_PewhB1rmXBg6aeQamQLQU8uUdPbhmLV2aMFoRC0WipFWTr8X32ryA%3D%3D)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose

Don’t be fooled—the threats to your wealth are bigger than politics.
# Trump Wins But Your Savings Lose?
Let’s get one thing straight: your wealth is under attack and no one’s coming to save it. Not even Trump. A lot of folks are betting on a Trump re-election to fix everything but here’s the harsh truth... The damage is already done—and it’s aimed directly at your retirement, your savings, and everything you’ve worked your whole life to build. [](http://email.bigleaguetruth.com/c/eJxckU-P0zAQxT-Nc2vljGM7OeQAeNPVahctRYIVFytx3NTF-YP_NGQ_PUoVKsRlDm9-mpn3pu4na05LifhHBHA2rUcAiHxAAN236yUe4f0l7LojpruHS_-M1y582tAr3OFB1Yf3IL7PQfjP7ketluFgr-kdD8uk7_C2dK_72thV5SJpS0I1YTTRZcqhIJxyjJNzyTKs6xPjOU8pOzFaFwVOM14UnBDFKU1MCRiyFKcFAGY020MOea4yWpAGCoo1ynBjOqvrLurgYjjv1dgntjyHMPnbQRWCap7nvVY_2-Li7QogqOD49fWJIqjY0-Nbla4cqXxsABGR4jRHwHxsCCLi9YiAxdDLXrcm9oiIzdpN9GN0SiMi_kl0UFZuMWyUqvupNt2AiLjZyXdrkZMzozNhkd1oWxlc7Cc5m8HLJga5jNFJX1_N0HlpR69lY8PfeeMQ9BAQEYOyu5e36B775fwrQ8DkYE2LiPhPvH2fCHF4-KJ-82eXuLKdZmOt8YyjDHerp1t41xL-BAAA__91hbGS) **Here’s what they won’t tell you on TV:**
* **The Fed’s printing trillions and your dollars are losing value fast.**
* Washington’s spending spree has pushed the national debt to crisis levels—**and YOU will pay the price.**

We’re closing the gap, Peter.

From day one, we’ve heard from the naysayers that the polling wasn’t on our side. But now, with less than two weeks left, we’ve not just closed the gap, we’re leading by just one point.

Peter, but here’s the bad news. We’re still in the margin of error. That means this is anyone’s race.

Including this one, we only have three more weekends before Election Day, which is why my team of staff and volunteers will be working through this weekend to get out the vote across New Mexico.

Even if you’re not able to help make phone calls, walk neighborhoods, or hand out literature, **_you can still help_**.

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

It’s the little efforts from everyday people like you that are the foundation of a winning campaign, and that’s why we’re going to win this fight. It means so much to my team and I to know you have our back while we’re out hitting the campaign trail. Thank you! Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. Why, you may ask? **Well, we’re just hours away from our final public filing deadline before Election Day.** [](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=151715931cd74dadaff68c7b75d4894c&_e=1iavhTjhqdMBJUAnbN2vWg5h4eH6aiRFQWmOsRxo7iNW-5q09s7V5eMzISNnPIpatqLhw15vrjOOodEWxv6bsz6w8chHAWtrTx9kysNwLmIXp1_xefv96i6wL_EdjEq4qgY-j8b_StLT63QeaIaaYT6Zmf91US_Vb7bfy_1bKwC_w1WNbPNoIzD5t75QeKyFoSY5lHeE2jRVMPLdmkVw_VmeeH3VZgzkIqBQuuSNG10j5ZvfUbI2qGUQO-SzIMNOzXERFTI3U0b-PJa0zCqOLZay_ZAmi74SCIEfqS9buBFec30wBwkDqYb7Xg5HUQ9XYBbF0WMuLNBXlUKPGwBw97soaO_y8Yk7z1IghPfXEkmcj6cD7WIl7VJnU4h_Ky-QxBCjAz9fqi49WkwVzh2JWhtMXb4OYAWxEh1ScPOJhNY%3D) **[My team set an ambitious goal of $1 million because we need to make sure we can keep our foot on the gas pedal until the very end. You deserve a leader who will change the course of the country for the better.
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d7be1a58aacf466ead37163cca92e09d&_e=hs98ZPpeMm6kzy8nc5kjoqJXyeYffPCkr_T9A1yeagz3XJThjxws9IRbsD23NtT5vGpv-idhIo66YRcXYfUjxcbbRuQ0er0TYR4c01JaS-KlGlwhMvMK3yO6Q68dbbQvgQz_zYVhRp2NZdfRrYCt32prOCQ20u6Pc6WUu909FqTzv-B_cXvg6400J4uTJuHXuxfu_cYC8g7d-g4-dfNPn2571gtm2M91GWNeDhd-7zTf2fDkrhpSOKnmQEx7fb3IlJb6epTphUd4y6toIDH0OTjBs7NNe78NYY8tR-gAjUlNATAgTh4-3kzb4SdpH30P0GKUna60ZGiuf3TTcMJUNzFl0uCHk9QVHWbELTDrMs-O4PEmeTIAkfmlp7ar017FZZCA1BbsS3OIryCuUjfn1_V-nMKFLv71x6hmbA11EP8%3D)

Peter,

If you watched the second debate, you heard a lot of “career politician talk” from my opponent Bob Casey.

He lied about me, he lied about his record, and he refused to take responsibility for the failures he and the rest of the DC liberals have caused to our economy and at the border.

**On Day One in the Army, you learn to take responsibility for your actions, but Bob Casey is a typical career politician. He takes zero responsibility. **

At one point he even had the nerve to lecture me about the conflict in the Middle East. _I went to West Point, Ranger School, and was a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne Division during the First Gulf War and received a Bronze Star for my service._

**I 'm not going to be lectured by a guy who has spent 30 years in elected office with NOTHING to show for it but a weak voting record that lines up 99% of the time with Biden/Harris.**

We had a code at West Point: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do. I'm not going to tolerate Bob Casey's lies.

I'm no stranger to tough battles. But with under 3 weeks left until Election Day, the polls locked in a dead heat, and control of the Senate majority hinging on the outcome of my race, **[I need your help in this fight.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d7be1a58aacf466ead37163cca92e09d&_e=hs98ZPpeMm6kzy8nc5kjoqJXyeYffPCkr_T9A1yeagz3XJThjxws9IRbsD23NtT5vGpv-idhIo66YRcXYfUjxcbbRuQ0er0TYR4c01JaS-KlGlwhMvMK3yO6Q68dbbQvgQz_zYVhRp2NZdfRrYCt32prOCQ20u6Pc6WUu909FqTzv-B_cXvg6400J4uTJuHXuxfu_cYC8g7d-g4-dfNPn2571gtm2M91GWNeDhd-7zTf2fDkrhpSOKnmQEx7fb3IlJb6epTphUd4y6toIDH0OQLFn8J3R19Vlax4Y0DYePUAGk3W_nJPzP5MCgdJu3ezBZqOov1rQIA39xbBvQsdNKo4glmiHJcm_OALVku8jjLrtC8KwR2-HdX9ISBtcDBOfg7nXmMvQrkF85LtQNtRpzmlwSjtVtgDb-sDheSMgCA%3D)**

It's not just on the debate stage where I'm facing an onslaught of attacks. **Democrats are pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into Pennsylvania to obliterate my chances of flipping the Senate Red.**

I cannot stress enough how close this race is.

We're locked in a tied race.

The outcome of this election will come down to a dogfight in the final days as we fight for _every. single. vote._

That's why I'm asking for your help to fund this final stretch, get my message out, and expose the truth about Bob Casey's failed liberal record.

**[Will you rush in anything you can to help me cut through the noise and get the truth out?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d7be1a58aacf466ead37163cca92e09d&_e=hs98ZPpeMm6kzy8nc5kjoqJXyeYffPCkr_T9A1yeagz3XJThjxws9IRbsD23NtT5vGpv-idhIo66YRcXYfUjxcbbRuQ0er0TYR4c01JaS-KlGlwhMvMK3yO6Q68dbbQvgQz_zYVhRp2NZdfRrYCt32prOCQ20u6Pc6WUu909FqTzv-B_cXvg6400J4uTJuHXuxfu_cYC8g7d-g4-dfNPn2571gtm2M91GWNeDhd-7zTf2fDkrhpSOKnmQEx7fb3IlJb6epTphUd4y6toIDH0OT55OXaj-pGlJOs8N63lAMf3wy8SZ580cmk1SEz-zDZHdG5xrtKNlPD0tujQpYnC8DFinFjR1ltNECeH81_5-XiCaxPBwwleTG_-J8PkxLEaRKoKhk_yKT-1ngJrWnOqlnTHUIJW25Gcsy_Yyf57w0Y%3D)**
[DONATE NOW](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d7be1a58aacf466ead37163cca92e09d&_e=hs98ZPpeMm6kzy8nc5kjoqJXyeYffPCkr_T9A1yeagz3XJThjxws9IRbsD23NtT5vGpv-idhIo66YRcXYfUjxcbbRuQ0er0TYR4c01JaS-KlGlwhMvMK3yO6Q68dbbQvgQz_zYVhRp2NZdfRrYCt32prOCQ20u6Pc6WUu909FqTzv-B_cXvg6400J4uTJuHXuxfu_cYC8g7d-g4-dfNPn2571gtm2M91GWNeDhd-7zTf2fDkrhpSOKnmQEx7fb3IlJb6epTphUd4y6toIDH0OXWvGmY_k-TRNns-SFEr1xcYFTSFh4RAuRMPxRlltZ87y5yMRDwZNWtgwBLtlb06lOwoUCWlQzoNOmcu--YolJ4JFjy22ZXClS-hiczaKEHG6qhAoO4pY-KEmtWS98qzq_iYiXnLjMxYIQZpuvjKSkM%3D)

**Here 's the truth about Bob Casey.** Bob Casey has accomplished NOTHING after 18 years in the U.S. Senate. He's supported policies that have increased the cost of living, left our border wide open, and he's supported a plan to raise taxes on working Pennsylvanians. He's anti-business and anti-success. And did I mention he wants to get rid of the Senate filibuster?

I'm running for Senate because Pennsylvanians deserve a leader who will fight for the American Dream. YOU deserve a leader who will change the course of the country for the better.

As a West Point cadet, I took an oath of "Duty, Honor, and Country." I live by that motto every day. It's how I've run my campaign and it's how I'll lead in the Senate.

But in order to get there, I need your help today. **[So if you are able, please chip in anything you can to my campaign before time runs out.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d7be1a58aacf466ead37163cca92e09d&_e=hs98ZPpeMm6kzy8nc5kjoqJXyeYffPCkr_T9A1yeagz3XJThjxws9IRbsD23NtT5vGpv-idhIo66YRcXYfUjxcbbRuQ0er0TYR4c01JaS-KlGlwhMvMK3yO6Q68dbbQvgQz_zYVhRp2NZdfRrYCt32prOCQ20u6Pc6WUu909FqTzv-B_cXvg6400J4uTJuHXuxfu_cYC8g7d-g4-dfNPn2571gtm2M91GWNeDhd-7zTf2fDkrhpSOKnmQEx7fb3IlJb6epTphUd4y6toIDH0OdH6YHLtT-wHs0-9XJKnRvochO--S9SjLDAHzicyVBuRGZj4TJAY2MS7BbkJxjeTOc8YVjvbdzIQW5KxZ1QftWoPnH0LIvw0GB8VKo4h7Hwyk8RFIWEmnBdExJBn3HiRGsSrHyXYw3IUzyyFDjGVBkY%3D)**

Thank you,
Dave McCormick

name: Jill Stein
subject: Democrats CHOSE to let Roe collapse
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=abortion_update&n=1)
---
Peter,

It’s been two years, three months, and 25 days since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned.

But the story neither begins nor ends there.

For nearly 50 years, our right to control our own bodies clung to the thinnest of threads – the judicial precedent established by radical right-wing elites masquerading as purveyors of justice.

From the moment _Roe_ was decided, conservative groups announced their intent to overturn it. They broadcast their plans loudly and often. And for five decades, Democrats did nothing about it but wring their hands (worse, they often sided with Republicans in policy and in rhetoric).

Today, Kamala Harris and the Democratic party want you to believe that only they can be trusted to restore reproductive freedom.

Well as they often say: Don’t tell me who you are – show me.

In the nearly 50 years that _Roe_ protected our bodily autonomy, Democrats controlled both chambers of Congress for no less than 22 of those years. For six of those years, they controlled both Congress AND the White House.

Democrats had multiple opportunities to codify _Roe_ , and they failed.

Even in 2022, when SCOTUS took up the Dobbs case and advertised their intentions...

Even when they leaked the decision nearly two months in advance..

Even when they issued the _Dobbs_ decision and struck down _Roe_...

_Even then Democrats didn’t get it done.

_ And now we are ALL living with the consequences.

Stories are pouring forth of women dying or suffering grave medical complications because they’re being denied an abortion or the emergency care they need.

In Texas alone, maternal mortality has spiked 56% (more than 5 times the Post-Roe national average). TENS OF THOUSANDS of new rape cases have been reported resulting in pregnancy. Harsh abortion bans are even leading to increasing infant mortality.

Hospitals in many red states have shut down maternity services altogether to avoid running afoul of their states’ bans. Even in “True Blue” California, a hospital recently refused an emergency abortion to a woman suffering a miscarriage – sending her away with a bucket and some towels.

**Republicans have been emboldened by their success, and are now pushing a national abortion ban, full stop.

****This is what 50 years of Democratic ineptitude and political malpractice has wrought.

** I practiced internal medicine for 25 years, and I remember the terrifying days before _Roe_ – watching close friends endure the horrors of back alley abortions. For all these reasons, I am furious.

I’m as furious with Republicans pushing these radical abortion bans as I am with decades of empty rhetoric from Democrats that continues to this day.

**Every single Democratic president since**** _Roe_****held a trifecta** (controlling both chambers of Congress and the White House) at some point in their presidency.

**With his trifecta in 2021-2022, Joe Biden could have guaranteed abortion rights before OR after**** _Dobbs_****. He didn’t.

** Even without the cooperation of his party in Congress, a Democratic president has tools at their disposal to immediately secure abortion access and challenge these bans – such as using federal lands to construct abortion clinics or expanding and packing the court.

Joe Biden has taken none of these measures, and we have no reason to believe his hand-picked successor will either.

**Never once in 51 years did Democrats make a serious effort to codify the right to an abortion into federal law.** But they did raise BILLIONS of dollars from ordinary Americans who entrusted them to fight for us.

**This is personal to me.** As a doctor I know all too well that pregnancy itself is often a life-threatening condition. As an activist and a mother, I believe fiercely that no one should ever be forced to remain pregnant.

[**Democrats will never sincerely defend your right to control your own body. The Green Party always has. As your president, so will I. Donate now to help me reach those still undecided voters in the final weeks of this campaign.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=abortion_update&n=2)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=abortion_update&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=abortion_update&n=3)
---
Kamala Harris keeps referring to our current nightmare as fallout from “Trump’s abortion ban.” But Trump couldn’t do this on his own. The inaction of the Democratic party is no less a betrayal of women than the extreme right-wing lawmakers and judges imposing these bans.

**Access to safe abortion is a non-negotiable human right.** It is healthcare, and like all healthcare it should be guaranteed and freely available for anyone who needs it.

When I am president, it will be.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

The fact is, a man who refuses to say he'd veto a national abortion ban will not stand up for reproductive freedom.

A man who bragged about his role in overturning _Roe v. Wade_ doesn't have the humility to support American families.

And quite simply, a man who fails to respect women does not have the morals to champion them. Period.

I spent much of my childhood in the same house that Donald grew up in, and this is the man I've always known: Cruel, fragile, and weak. **The fight to defeat him is deeply personal to me.**

name: Team Gallego
subject: We owe Ruben an explanation
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
If we don’t raise another $150,000 by midnight, we’re going to have to cut our advertising budget by half.
#

Peter,
Here’s where things stand for the day:
We have our daily fundraising report-out with Ruben in a little less than an hour. We made solid progress to our goals ahead of our FEC deadline on the 16th, but we’ve slowed down considerably since then.
We owe Ruben an explanation as to why. And, honestly, we don’t have one.
We can’t point to anything that explains this slowdown. This race is as tight in our internals as it ever has been. We’re lagging the GOP in ballot returns. There are still wide swaths of undecided voters, and we’ve got a ton of advertising and outreach that has to be paid for.**And President Obama himself was just in Arizona to remind everybody how urgent the situation is.**
To put it bluntly, we’re pretty stressed out. And if we don’t raise another $150,000 by midnight, we’re going to have to cut our advertising budget by half.
We can’t count on massive checks from millionaires and billionaires to close the gap. This campaign relies on grassroots support from folks like you giving whatever you can, whenever you can.
So, before we meet with Ruben, we’re asking you for help.

Able Dems is proud to endorse Tammy Balwin, a steadfast champion who deserves our unwavering support in her campaign for re-election to the U.S. Senate from Wisconsin. Tammy's journey began at just nine years old when she faced a serious illness that left her hospitalized for three months. After her recovery, she was denied coverage due to a “pre-existing condition” label—a lesson that fueled her passion for healthcare reform. Thanks to her tireless advocacy, the Affordable Care Act now allows young people to stay on their parents’ insurance until age 26, protecting millions from the perils of inadequate healthcare. Tammy’s personal experiences, including caring for her grandmother and witnessing the devastating effects of the opioid epidemic, have driven her commitment to strengthen Medicare and Social Security, as well as support family caregivers. As her opponent seeks to undermine these vital services and disparage seniors, it is critical that we defend Tammy’s Senate seat to maintain a Democratic majority. clean_body: | | | Able Dems is proud to endorse Tammy Balwin, a steadfast champion who deserves our unwavering support in her campaign for re-election to the U.S. Senate from Wisconsin. Tammy's journey began at just nine years old when she faced a serious illness that left her hospitalized for three months. After her recovery, she was denied coverage due to a “pre-existing condition” label—a lesson that fueled her passion for healthcare reform. Thanks to her tireless advocacy, the Affordable Care Act now allows young people to stay on their parents’ insurance until age 26, protecting millions from the perils of inadequate healthcare. Tammy’s personal experiences, including caring for her grandmother and witnessing the devastating effects of the opioid epidemic, have driven her commitment to strengthen Medicare and Social Security, as well as support family caregivers. Friend, for well over a year now, you’ve been getting messages from my husband Mike Rogers, his campaign staff, and his supporters about how this is the most consequential election of our lifetime, why Mike is the best man for the job, and why if Mike wins, we take back the Senate.
All of that is true.

**[But after 13 months on the campaign trail — I wanted to share with you a bit of my story, and how I know that Mike Rogers is a man worthy of your support. ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=ed09dfb553ef4336ae3156cc02fa6d3c&_e=o48eK7dEIyOAH6wI6vdgvVwRptunPwJMs7N_4AO6ocphnFBCAyE325vsYD3_QQ6qD2zSTUXorvaCNiIv6w-np6k67JVZw2USPgv7mb3c8B26BP-T_pOkR04YgwB4rZWWcubcb8LPa3D_IXUciq4jQCY9ldE5biBO8-WiUq-JNkMu04lRxNtNbUoa5uBvaUpEB3NNPcncmCbaL5GyvXUEBXG6_arTO5CS9KpvS6KQuiIt1F6SFry6oEoC-3LZZs0oDdHzD2KbIv-055_L0byJvSZV_iLvJUo5Qq2FbvUuotu4ozQqWl-NMZFGwZ_M7pbDtlP8bJ8UiiwVw4viY2LYgJY6MoPKb6lw-d0zeXdghhRpPZOm8vU_DliKDhTeIC-BSs4dAmAZTxfFitZHepseIQDq5PdE94AOUTvhGZpuRGfyO8VYB2tn_Jq-iLeSvEJsT8gjwbEmhB8epGePPVq_thSlNbx4fHkFaBj-LpB8QA0%3D)**

I was deployed to Iraq in the height of the conflict in the Middle East while working for the Department of Defense.

Here’s a picture of me from back then:

[](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=ed09dfb553ef4336ae3156cc02fa6d3c&_e=o48eK7dEIyOAH6wI6vdgvVwRptunPwJMs7N_4AO6ocphnFBCAyE325vsYD3_QQ6qD2zSTUXorvaCNiIv6w-np6k67JVZw2USPgv7mb3c8B26BP-T_pOkR04YgwB4rZWWcubcb8LPa3D_IXUciq4jQCY9ldE5biBO8-WiUq-JNkMu04lRxNtNbUoa5uBvaUpEB3NNPcncmCbaL5GyvXUEBXG6_arTO5CS9KpvS6KQuiIt1F6SFry6oEoC-3LZZs0oDdHzD2KbIv-055_L0byJvSZV_iLvJUo5Qq2FbvUuotu4ozQqWl-NMZFGwZ_M7pbDtlP8bJ8UiiwVw4viY2LYgB_qA-vM-gU-P9BoXRN9diuS9ePdrhD5DxuOO6MKw9PVMrn8CL8RO35LaHhjm23he3Ny37KYJ4QAn7i59Q5cyT3wx7n_t6QsX2cyZE0WF3dQ1XCfS05jtV0Q4511yGrOc9uMl_hh6ll5YzXRUDN-w58%3D)

And on a fateful day, my team and I were traveling through the city of Baghdad. You have to understand that just getting around the region as Americans at this point was incredibly dangerous. We were told to stay in the middle lane of the highway, to keep as much of a distance between us and the explosive devices that lined the roads as possible. The terrorists were always waiting for their opportunity to attack. **_[Suddenly — it happened. ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=ed09dfb553ef4336ae3156cc02fa6d3c&_e=o48eK7dEIyOAH6wI6vdgvVwRptunPwJMs7N_4AO6ocphnFBCAyE325vsYD3_QQ6qD2zSTUXorvaCNiIv6w-np6k67JVZw2USPgv7mb3c8B26BP-T_pOkR04YgwB4rZWWcubcb8LPa3D_IXUciq4jQCY9ldE5biBO8-WiUq-JNkMu04lRxNtNbUoa5uBvaUpEB3NNPcncmCbaL5GyvXUEBXG6_arTO5CS9KpvS6KQuiIt1F6SFry6oEoC-3LZZs0oDdHzD2KbIv-055_L0byJvSZV_iLvJUo5Qq2FbvUuotu4ozQqWl-NMZFGwZ_M7pbDtlP8bJ8UiiwVw4viY2LYgFD4rFnTQPtddLdq85mOvs3V4TRMeWLmM6TO-N4qYTKTLmlcPVU3asp889gb4vVNlZ9awjHvElwpYyX-ojeiiAkkHobt-NHvwOrNptVCy-BPXWxV2D7472z-BmK4NRUMDQpTBv0phSpP_TkGBm6OtnQ%3D)_** I can still remember what it was like to have my head spinning, with my ears ringing and surrounded by smoke. When I finally realized what happened, I was incredibly grateful to have made it out alive, as others in the car next to us were not as lucky. After this incident, my husband often jokes that when there’s a bump in the night at home,_he sends me to check things out and make sure we are safe_. **[But the truth is that my husband, Mike Rogers, is the strongest, most courageous, and honorable man I’ve ever known.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=ed09dfb553ef4336ae3156cc02fa6d3c&_e=o48eK7dEIyOAH6wI6vdgvVwRptunPwJMs7N_4AO6ocphnFBCAyE325vsYD3_QQ6qD2zSTUXorvaCNiIv6w-np6k67JVZw2USPgv7mb3c8B26BP-T_pOkR04YgwB4rZWWcubcb8LPa3D_IXUciq4jQCY9ldE5biBO8-WiUq-JNkMu04lRxNtNbUoa5uBvaUpEB3NNPcncmCbaL5GyvXUEBXG6_arTO5CS9KpvS6KQuiIt1F6SFry6oEoC-3LZZs0oDdHzD2KbIv-055_L0byJvSZV_iLvJUo5Qq2FbvUuotu4ozQqWl-NMZFGwZ_M7pbDtlP8bJ8UiiwVw4viY2LYgCU5NU5eo-xNJ4WYa3O7qRiqXd5P7QYup7Lgy0mJc1qtE9QFfvzOTp4Mq-00deadXpZLBa2fmvbxJ7eJ1vZO5ibjly0CQqVkKo4NrH6rVn5FXEmKqu6c4GMeuFvbukIE6caPdD7GUyQM-_bxVy-fIRo%3D)** It takes guts to get back into politics these days — especially with the folks on the other side spending tens of millions of dollars to lie about you and your family in the name of scoring cheap political points. As a young man, Mike fought cancer and worked two jobs — one on the floor of an automotive factory, and one in security — just to put himself through college. My husband is an Army veteran, former FBI agent, and even chaired the House Intelligence Committee in the tough days after 9/11. He also has been taking the fight to Communist China — going so far as to break from his fellow Republicans to blow the whistle on the threats that the CCP poses. _It just doesn’t get any tougher than that. _
Mike is the kind of man that does what is right, no matter the personal consequence.

**[And he is the kind of man that is deserving of your support. Because with Mike in the Senate, you can know that there is someone in your corner, fighting for you and preserving our great American values.](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=ed09dfb553ef4336ae3156cc02fa6d3c&_e=o48eK7dEIyOAH6wI6vdgvVwRptunPwJMs7N_4AO6ocphnFBCAyE325vsYD3_QQ6qD2zSTUXorvaCNiIv6w-np6k67JVZw2USPgv7mb3c8B26BP-T_pOkR04YgwB4rZWWcubcb8LPa3D_IXUciq4jQCY9ldE5biBO8-WiUq-JNkMu04lRxNtNbUoa5uBvaUpEB3NNPcncmCbaL5GyvXUEBXG6_arTO5CS9KpvS6KQuiIt1F6SFry6oEoC-3LZZs0oDdHzD2KbIv-055_L0byJvSZV_iLvJUo5Qq2FbvUuotu4ozQqWl-NMZFGwZ_M7pbDtlP8bJ8UiiwVw4viY2LYgLmbgqzB_zLGtTPKabx61WdlPmjgB5pP5P13mnmsx82GhcuvohMF5wEx7JENlWTElpoG_3g0hpQH-JWoiy0UQMcc9pZNxlHgOTaJ7JBJwJRGk3DUW7LL4GqhsUJQc2scWC2oeSZIK8ni-6euc1bovKY%3D) **
